summary: The way an LDP speaker advertises labels for a Forwarding Equivalence Class depends on the FEC type, not necessarily on the session's negotiated mode. This document updates RFC 5036 to say so and specifies the advertisement mode for all FEC types defined at the time.

eli5.summary: Routers hand out numbered tags to mark traffic. This RFC clears up that the type of traffic decides how tags are offered, whatever the routers first agreed to.

questions: ldp label advertisement mode per fec
